_note: HFGCS recorder configuration. Detector thresholds marked PROVISIONAL are not yet calibrated against real empty-channel audio and must not be trusted until Phase 1 supplies it.

frequencies._note: UDXF revision 17 May 2025 marks this not active; enable only if traffic is observed

receiver._note: AGC settings are load-bearing. A 0.1 s AGC time constant is a ~1.6 Hz corner on the audio envelope, which notches the exact 0.2-3 Hz band the detector depends on and cost 75% of the discriminating feature in bench measurement. Slow AGC or fixed gain only.
receiver._verifyBeforePhase1: exact kiwirecorder/kiwi-client AGC parameter names and units are NOT yet confirmed against the client source
receiver._wfNote: Opens a second WebSocket per session for RF spectrum. Costs NO extra rx channel (one session id serves both sockets) but ~1 KB/s of bandwidth. Gives thumbnails ~29 kHz wide instead of the 6 kHz ceiling of demodulated audio.

session._note: One slot on one receiver per frequency, released and reselected on a cap. Smaller footprint than a human who parks on 11175 all evening.

siteSelection._note: Filter then rank. Pool is seeded from the survey cohort but is deliberately wider, because the cohort's capacity check systematically skipped the popular (i.e. good) receivers -- the survey's own hole #1.

detector._note: Feature roles established by bench measurement against a real 146 s EAM capture (8992 kHz, 27 Jun 2016) plus synthetic negatives. Reference values: EAM modFraction 0.737, flatness 0.368, harmonicity 0.275. Band-limited noise 0.204 / 0.562 / 0.191. AGC'd empty channel 0.025 / 0.562 / 0.191. Carrier birdie 0.210 / 0.071 / 0.840.
detector._PROVISIONAL: modFractionAbsMin and modFractionRatioOverFloor are placeholders. The uploaded reference contains zero empty channel, so it constrains the positive class only and cannot set a threshold. Calibrate against >= 1 hour of real quiet channel before trusting any false-positive claim.
detector._flatnessNote: Rejects steady carriers and birdies, which score 0.84 on harmonicity -- higher than speech -- and would otherwise trigger constantly.
detector._harmonicityNote: Never use as a primary discriminator. See flatnessNote.
detector._energyNote: Level arrives flat through receiver AGC; frame energy carried no usable information across the entire reference recording.
detector._snrNote: Feature separation held to roughly 0 dB SNR even through a deliberately hostile 0.1 s AGC. Unmeasured with correct AGC settings.

propagationGate._note: Whether a frequency is worth a KiwiSDR slot right now. Holding 4724 kHz through local noon consumes a volunteer's receiver to listen to a dead band. When no eligible receiver has a plausibly open path the worker RELEASES its slot and sleeps. 24H frequencies (8992, 11175) score flat and never gate closed. minScore 0.35 opens the night bands below +3.5deg solar elevation and the day band above -3.5deg, so grayline is included on both sides.

ringBuffer._note: 6 ch x 60 s x 12 kHz x 2 B = 8.6 MB. Pre-roll is not optional: trigger-on-detect loses the first syllable of every transmission.

masking._note: Some sysops mask HFGCS frequencies. A masked channel returns floor-flat audio while adjacent spectrum behaves normally. Undetected, it logs as a quiet receiver rather than a gagged one.

correlation._note: HFGCS simulcasts, so one transmission fires several channels at once. Collapsing them is both a dedup and a self-check: a real event appears on 3+ channels, a false positive on one.

output._note: 24 kbps mono is transparent for a 2.7 kHz SSB passband; about 10.8 MB per hour of captured audio.

identification._note: Identify the project to sysops. Cheap, and the difference between a tool people tolerate and one they block.

coverage._note: Rotation and slot contention mean transmissions will be missed. Report the gaps rather than letting the page imply completeness.
